👤 Select Employee

All access sections are always shown below. Pick an employee here to tick the boxes that already apply to them — everything else stays unticked. Tick/untick whatever you need, then save.

Loading...
🔑 Select Admin

All access sections are always shown below. Pick a non-MIS/Director admin here to tick the boxes that already apply to them — everything else stays unticked (Director shown separately as always-full-access; Director/EA/Manager/Store Manager/Asst Manager etc. all appear here individually — access is set per PERSON, not per job title).

📢 Send Alert

Pops up repeatedly until you turn it off below — not a one-time notification.

🏪 Store Details

Shows on the login page and everywhere else the store's own details appear. Saved directly to the same "Store Settings" sheet used for the logo/background below — no more hand-editing the sheet.

🖼️ Store Logo

Upload once — this logo replaces the ✦ mark on the login page, topbar and sidebar everywhere, with no background box around it.

Login Background Image

Optional — shows behind the login card instead of the plain purple. Upload a photo any time; set its expiry date separately below, whenever you want — once it passes, this is removed automatically and the login page goes back to the default purple theme on its own. You can also remove it yourself any time with the Remove Image button, no need to wait for the expiry.

No background image set (login page shows the default purple theme).
⏱️ Auto-Logout Timer

No activity (mouse/touch/keyboard) for this long auto-logs-out any Employee or Admin login on the portal.

🔍 Customer 360°

Search by mobile number, customer name, Loyalty Card No, Golden Plan No, or DSR ID to see every visit, Loyalty Card, Golden Aura plan, Lead call, and DSR purchase on record for them.

⚠️ Extra DSR Check

Compares each employee's own reported Walk-in purchase count against actual DSR entries for the same date. More DSR entries than reported purchases usually means an old, unbilled sale got entered under today's date by mistake. Informational only — this never affects KPI scoring.

Pick a date range and tap Check.

🔁 Duplicate Tag No

Same Tag No (Gold or Diamond) entered under two different DSR Nos — usually an accidental re-entry of an already-billed piece. Delete the wrong entry below; it drops off this list automatically once resolved.

Tap Check to scan for duplicate Tag Nos.

⚠️ Duplicate Tag No Entries
Same Tag No entered a second time — usually an offline entry that missed the live "already sold" check. MIS has also been emailed.
⚠️ Walk-in Track: Deal Count Mismatch
Customer Deals should equal Purchased + Non Purchased for that row. These rows don't add up — check and correct the entry.
📊 Leads Performance — Tonight
Today's calling status: how many got entered, how many are still pending, and how many were voided (with reason).
🎉 Customer Events — Pending
Your assigned customers with a birthday/anniversary in the next 7 days. Confirm all three for each one to clear it.

📧 Mail Issues
Employees with no e-mail or a bouncing e-mail are blocked at login until they verify a new one. You can let someone continue for a short time.

⚠️ System Alert
The automatic health check found problem(s). Tap "Got it" once you have seen a problem. It comes back only if it keeps happening.
✏️ Employee DSR Edit
Each DSR can be edited once by the employee. Every edit comes to you here with old and new values, and the DSR changes only after your OK. For a second edit, switch edit ON again below.
